tei:div.tei:p: "$ (421)༄༅// theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong gi rtsa tshig bzhugs so/// /

(422)༄༅// dpal bkra shis rin po che myur du bde ba thams cad sbyin pa don grub pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ rten gyi gang zag skyes bu gsum la blo sbyong zhing smon 'jug gnyis blangs nas bslab bya shes pa gcig gis/ dang po sngon 'gro dag la bslab/ dal 'byor thob dka' ba las rgyu 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam/ rang gzhan phyi nang snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i chos rnams rmi lam sems 'khrul pa'i dbang gis med bzhin snang ba lta bur bsam/ de ltar rtogs mkhan gyi blo gnyis ma 'gags pa'i ma skyes rig pa'i gshis la ngos gzung bral bar dpyod/ de ltar lus sems gnyis la dpyod byed kyi gnyen po nyid kyang rang sar grol/ yod med du 'dzin pa dang bral ba/ de'i rjes la thun mtshams sgyu ma'i skyes pa'i dus su 'dor len gnyis la brten nas skyes bur bya/ lus longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge ba thams cad gzhan la gtong len gnyis po spel mar sbyang*/ gtong len de gnyis phyir 'gro nang 'gro rlung la bskyon par bya/ yul sdug mi sdug bar ma gsum dug gsum chags sdang gti mug med pa'i dge rtsa gsum/ 'chags pa la sogs pa'i spyod lam kun tu rjes su yid bar ma chad pa tshig gis sbyang*/ phyi snod nang bcud 'bras bu duḥkha sdig pa 'khol zhing nyon mongs pa med pa yi/ sems can dang 'byung ba las gyur pa'i rkyen ngan ci byung thams cad byang chub lam du/ kyi grogs su bsgyur/ ji ltar na le len thams cad mi 'dod pa ci byang ba thams cad gzhan la mi bda' bar (423)bdag 'dzin gcig la bda'/ mi dang mi min dgra gnyen khyad par du gnod byed kun la bka' drin che bar bsgom/ rang sems nas gnod bya gnod byed du 'khrul snang sku bzhir lag bcangs su bar ma chad pa sgom pa yis/ stong nyid thams cad sems kyi ngo bo srung ba rnams kyi nang nas bla na med/ sbyor ba lha dang bla ma mchod pa sdig pa sbyong ba gdon la mchod pa chos skyong mchod pa bzhi ldan thabs kyi mchog

/'phral la sdug bsngal dang chags sdang drag po skye ba'i rkyen ngan gang 'dug bsgom du sbyar/ sems gcig tu nyams su blang ba'i man ngag snying po mdor bsdus pa/ stobs lnga dag goms pa la sbyar bar bya ste 'phen pa'i dkar po'i sa bon gyi goms pa'i sun 'byin pa'i smon lam gyi'o// pha rol du phyin pa'i lugs kyis theg chen 'pho ba'i gdams ngag ni/ sngar gyi stobs lnga nyid yin gnas brten pa'o/ khyad par du spyod lam gyi gnad bca' ba gces// chos kun dgongs pa gcig tu 'dus/pas bdag 'dzin de thul ma thul blta ba'o// dbang po gzhan gyi ngag dang rang gi sems de gnyis rang gi sems kyis ma khrel ba gtso bo bzung*/ yid bde 'ba' zhig rgyun du brten/ gnyen po yongs kyang thub na blo 'byongs pa yin/ blo sbyong de'ang khas blangs dang mi 'gal/ tho cor ma song*/ phyogs reng ma song ba'i spyi don gsum la rtag tu bslab/ sngon la rang gces par 'dzin/ 'dod thog tu blo sbyong las 'byung ngo*// pa'i 'don pa bsgyur la ma bcos pa'i don la rang sor lus ngag gi sbyor ba bzhag /(424)yan lag nyams pa brjod mi bya/ khyad par du chos sgor zhugs pa'i gzhan phyogs gang yang mi bsam mo// blo sbyongs pas tshe 'di dang phyi mar tha na sangs rgyas thob par 'bras bu re ba thams cad srang*/ dug dang 'dra ba bdag 'dzin dang 'dres pa'i dge ba can gyi zas spong*/ gzhan gyi gnod pa byas pa zhes 'chad ba'i gzhung bzang po mi bsten/ gzhan gyi snying la gzer ba'i shag ngan ma dgong*/ zhe len 'jal ba'i 'phrang ma sgug /mi dang mi ma yin dang bu la yang skyon gyis gnong la mi dbab/ mi 'dod pa'i khag ngan gzhan la bkal ba mdzo khal glang la ma 'byo/ mgyogs 'dod pa phyi pa na yod pa la rang la snang gtod pa kyi rtse ma gtod/ pham blangs pas mjug rang rgyal du re ba'i gto log mi bya/ lha dang 'dra ba'i blo sbyong bdud du mi dbab/

rang skyid kyi bar 'dod pa'i yan lag tu gzhan la sdug ma tshol/ zas la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor thams cad gcig gis bya/ la gzhan med kyi/ thog ma nangs par dang mtha' ma dgongs gnyis la dpyod pa yis bya ba gnyis/ rim pa ltar 'byor pa dang rgud pa gnyis po gang byung*/ yang mi khangs pa dang rang zhum pa med par bzod par bya/ gnyis po chos spyi nas bshad pa'i dam tshig dang khyad par du 'di nyid nas bshad pa'i dam tshig srog dang bsngos la bsrung*/ nyon mongs pa gnyen po dran dka' bar du zlog dka' tha mar rgyun bcad dka' ba dka' ba gsum la bslab par bya/ bla ma 'od du 'then dgos mtshan ldan rang gi blo bkol du btub phyi nang gi mthun rkyen tshang ba ste/ rgyu yi gtso bo rnam gsum blang*// nyams pa med pa bla ma la gus pa blo sbyong la spro ba khas slang srung sems rnam gsum bsgom/ dge sbyong gsum dang lus ngag yid gsum 'grogs nges su 'dug pa 'bral med gsum dang ldan par bya/ sa gcig na 'dud pa/ rang la sdang ba/ rang gi yid du mi 'ong ba bkol ba rnams la rtag tu bsgom/ blo sbyong 'di bsgom pa'i drin de rkyen gzhan dag la ltos mi dgos par dang blta bar mi bya/ blo sbyong 'di sgom dus mi btub par blo'am rgyu mtshan du byas pa log na de nyid gnyen por bsgom/ dal 'byor thob cing bla ma dam pa dang mjal ba'i dus las dang gtso bor gyur pa byang sems da res gtso bo nyams su (425)blang*/ blo sbyong spro dgas bslab pa la go log drug mi bya/ sbyong mi sbyong res 'jog mi bya btub mi btub tshad len du mi bya bar dol chod du sbyang*/ bdag 'dzin spong na rang rgyud la des gos sam ma gos/ rtog dpyod gnyid kyis thar bar bya/ su la yang gang gis dgos dus nam yang yus ma sgom/ rang la gzhan gyis ji ltar byas kyang sems kyis ko long mi bsdam// dga' mi dga'i rnam 'gyur ston pa'i ngo mi rig

/yud tsam pa mi bya/ 'or che zhes pa'i tshig gi gtong rag tsam yang ma 'dod/ pha lam dang rdo rje nyi ma ljon shing ltar nga rnam sman dang phan sman chen pos/ 'di'i rjod byed dang brjod bya/ tshig don la sogs shes par sgom pa'i dgos pa la sogs bya/ bcom ldan 'das kyis byams pa la/ byams pas slob dpon thogs med la/ des dbyig gnyen la/ des thir ma ti/ des ku su lu che ba/ des ku su lu chung ba/ des bla ma gser gling pa'o// snyigs ma lnga po bdo ba 'di/ blo rmongs sgom pa'i 'gal rkyen mang la de tsa na blo 'byongs pas/ byang chub lam du bsgyur ba yin// jo bo chen po'i thugs dam 'phags pa byams pa nas brgyud pa'i gdams ngag rdzogs so// lha sde'i dang 'byor rgud la res 'gal ba/ rang gzhan la rgyu sdig pa phyogs su 'dzin pa thams cad spang*/ dus snyigs ma kun slong nyon mongs pa thams cad theg chen lam du bsgyur/ mi sde rnal 'byor thams cad spyod lam dang*/ bya ba dang gting 'byongs kun la sems kyi skad cig ma skyes tshad 'dis ngo bo sdug bsngal la sogs pa gces/ gtong len gnyis dngos dang yan lag dam tshig dang bslab bya gnyis ka sbyangs/ rtag 'jun lha 'dre rnam gsum la mi bya bar bdag 'dzin spong len drag tu bya/ mi mthun sgom gyi grogs su bsgyur/ gtong len bsgom snying mi 'dod pa'i gzhan gyi gnod pa byas snyam pa la sogs pa rgyu mtshan thams cad gzhom par bya/ rang gi rgyud la nyen btags nas gal che ba de'i gnyen po brten pa nyon mongs gang che sngon du sbyong*/ sems can thams cad la nye ring byams sdang*/ mtho dman bem rig dang 'di la blo le lan (426)thams cad grogs su 'gyur ba dang gtam thos pa tsam gyis nus pa yul la phyogs med dag tu sbyang*/ yon tan gzhan las khyad par 'phags/ gnyis pos bshul kyung ba bzhed kyis de nyid rang la tshad nas thams cad blang*/ yang dang yang du nyams su blang ba sla bar bslab/

tshe mjug la smin rgyu rang gi rtsa ba'i ma len pa'i go rim rang nas brtsams/ bdag gzhan brje ba bsgom pa bya ba'i mtshan nyid btang ba yin/ 'di phyi 'khor 'das thams cad la chags zhen/ 'byongs rtags chen po lnga ldan yin/ 'dir ngos sa thob pa'i rtogs pa yin kyang da lta nas bsam pa byang sems dang gces pa byas bzhin gyi mgron po mi bya/ dag gsal mi bya nyes skyon mi 'byung bas rang gis/ gzhan la re ltos mi bya/ rdzogs so// gzhan gyis sdug bsngal byung gis// 'dul 'dzin dge slong sgom pa gtso bo// rigs mang po blang*/ 'khor ba'i rgyu thams cad kyis ma shol bar bya snyam du/ ma 'ongs pa la rtag tu go bgo/ brtan pa thob nas gsang ba bstan/ gtong len gnyis la zab mo'i don bdag dang*/ gzhan dang*/ sdig sdug bde sogs grub la myong ba'o// blo sbyong gi gzhung rdzogs so// maṅga lam//
